# 01Deck

> 01Deck is an agent workspace for 01Protocol identities: create, verify, and chat with
> AI agents that carry cryptographically signed 01Protocol identity records.

01Deck is a client-side single-page application (SPA). Content on this site is rendered by
JavaScript after page load; a crawler that does not execute JavaScript will see only the
shell in index.html. The machine-readable agent catalog at /agents.json is provided as a
static alternative for indexing the built-in agent roster.

## Product modes

01Deck ships in two product profiles, selected at build time via VITE_PRODUCT_PROFILE:

- Deck (default) — the general agent workspace: browse, create, and chat with agents.
- Foundry — a focused profile for customer-support agent optimization.

Both modes share the same underlying agent, identity, and chat infrastructure described below.

## Agents

01Deck ships with a roster of pre-built seed agents, each with a name, role, category,
description, and a 01Protocol identity (protocolId). The full roster is available as
structured data at /agents.json. Users can also create custom agents through the in-app
agent creator.

## 01Protocol identity

Every agent created in 01Deck is issued a 01Protocol identity (an Ed25519 keypair and
signed identity record) via the vendored @01protocol/sdk. On first agent creation, the
installation also enrolls a local "owner" identity, and each agent's identity is bound to
that owner via a signed delegation token. Identity and delegation material is stored in the
browser's local storage for that installation; it is not synced to a server.

## Exporting and deploying agents

- Download Archive (.zip) — a real, working export. Produces a .zip containing the agent's
  signed 01Protocol identity files (.01ai / .01bundle), portrait, and memory/log folder
  scaffolding, saved directly to the user's device via the browser's download mechanism.
- Local Quick Deploy — a planned feature for a future desktop/backend build that would write
  agent files directly to a local directory (e.g. ~/.01protocol). It is not implemented in
  the current browser build and is shown disabled with that explanation. Use Download
  Archive to get an agent's files today.

## Chat

01Deck's chat can run in one of three modes, and the interface labels which one is active
(Live vs Simulated) rather than presenting simulated output as if it were a live model:

- Direct provider key — the user supplies their own API key client-side; requests go
  straight to that provider.
- Backend — the app talks to a companion backend service (01Evolve) for auth/session
  management and model access, when one is configured and reachable.
- Local/simulated fallback — when no key and no reachable authenticated backend are
  available, chat falls back to local canned/simulated responses so the UI remains usable
  for exploration, and is labeled "Simulated" accordingly.

See the "Chat Backend Configuration" section of the project README for the environment
variables that enable the backend mode.
